questions.q: What does the income statement report?
options: A business's revenues and expenses over a period of time, resulting in net income or net loss
A business's assets and liabilities at a single point in time
questions.explain: The income statement reports revenue and expenses over a stretch of time (a month, quarter, or year), netting down to net income or net loss.

questions.q: How is the income statement best described compared to the balance sheet?
options: The income statement is a snapshot of a single moment, like the balance sheet
They are identical reports with different names
The income statement is a 'video' covering a period of time, while the balance sheet is a 'snapshot' of one moment
The income statement only covers cash transactions
questions.explain: The income statement covers a time period (a video), whereas the balance sheet captures a single point in time (a snapshot), covered in the next lesson.

questions.q: Juniper Hollow Trading Co. has $500,000 of total revenue and $408,000 of total expenses. What is its net income?
questions.explain: $500,000 revenue minus $408,000 expenses equals $92,000 net income.

questions.q: Where does the income statement's net income ultimately flow to?
options: Nowhere — it has no connection to any other financial statement
Directly into Retained Earnings, part of the equity section of the balance sheet
It is converted entirely into cash
questions.explain: Net income flows into Retained Earnings each period, directly connecting the income statement to the balance sheet's equity section.

questions.q: In Oracle Fusion, where does an income statement report's underlying data come from?
options: Summarized revenue and expense balances flowing in from subledgers and accrual-based adjusting entries
It is manually typed in by an administrator each period
Only from the Fixed Assets module
It has no connection to subledgers or adjusting entries at all
questions.explain: Oracle Fusion General Ledger generates income statement reports from summarized revenue and expense balances, built from subledger activity and adjusting entries.
